contract.scope: One canonical follower-count wheel shared by God/Raja and authorized full Vessel callers; same counts/odds/reward rows, real source-bound projection.
contract.countMeaning: Followers/devotees are separate from army, command, victims and owned races. No army-control grant.

fixedOdds.source: User clarified nine-value ratio; earlier incomplete seven-value ratio is not active.

contract.rewardSelection: Only the exact committed count row for the declared caller applies. Working interpretation: rewards do not accumulate earlier count thresholds.
contract.rewardPolicyGuard: Require actual source and matching authorized profile: God race -> god; Raja race -> demon-lord; explicitly authorized Vessel90/100 -> profile matching actual god/demon-lord patron via authorizedAdditionalCallers. Other/mismatched callers are configuration errors; never fake a source race component.
contract.execution: Commit count, append scoped follower record and selected reward ledger atomically before one reaction; resume next child or saved caller.
contract.idempotence: runId/sourceComponentId/sourceFollowerInvocationId/rewardProfileId/effectOrdinal; replay/media retry repeats no record, bonus or spin.
contract.numericStats: Register numeric-point effects once; wait for each immutable base stat or recompute existing base plus ledger. Respect bounds/mappings; no tier increments or respins.
contract.mastery: Only demon-lord selected100/1000/10000/100000 gives one shared-rank modifier from actual Raja or authorized full-Raja Vessel follower source. God profile never gives follower mastery. Preserve bound Authority max; no extra draw.
contract.provenance: Separate follower records by source component; one God/Raja source never overwrites another count.
contract.history: No race/count exclusion inferred here; global race history still filters separately authorized identity draws.

authorizedAdditionalCallers.guard: Actual committed Vessel patron god, compatibility90 or100, and this recipe's actual follower child.
authorizedAdditionalCallers.projection: Use the existing matching byFollowerCount row and modifier amounts; bind all records/effects to actual Vessel/compatibility/follower source, never fabricate a God/Raja owned-race component. Follower display/context belongs to the selected patron.

powerMasteryModifiers.callerGuard: demon-lord reward profile from actual Raja Iblis Agung OR explicitly authorized full-Raja Vessel follower invocation with matching patron and90/100 compatibility.
powerMasteryModifiers.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
powerMasteryModifiers.sourceSpinBinding: sourceSpinId is the actual follower-count spin, not the parent subtype spin.
powerMasteryModifiers.godBoundary: God follower policy never grants this modifier; preserve independently acquired God Authority maximum overrides.
powerMasteryModifiers.emptyInventory: No phantom power or mastery draw.
